notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{R}.
Vedalkan Mastermind does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate all mana producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{R}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Great Oak Guardian from your hand onto the battlefield.
Great Oak Guardian enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Vedalken Mastermind by paying {U} and tapping it, returning Great Oak Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
